invariants: Order.status == 'pending' is an open cart: stage == 'not-shipped', carrier == null, tracking_number == null (a cart is not a placed order)
Order.tracking_number == null iff Order.stage == 'not-shipped'  (a shipment number exists only once the parcel is dispatched)
Customer.orders == count of that Customer's Order records with status != 'pending'  (an open cart does not count toward lifetime orders)
Payment.status == 'captured' implies its Order.status == 'paid'  (a capture is what marks an order paid)
Order.status == 'paid' implies exactly one 'captured' Payment references it  (an open-cart / pending order has no captured Payment)

fields.name: string
fields.status: enum: in-stock | low-stock | out-of-stock (derived from stock)

fields.name: string
fields.orders: integer — lifetime placed-order count (Order records with status != 'pending')

fields.status: enum: pending | paid | shipped | refunded — payment/lifecycle state (pending == open cart)
fields.stage: enum: not-shipped | shipped | in-transit | delivered — fulfilment/delivery stage
fields.carrier: string | null — shipping carrier once the parcel is dispatched, else null
fields.tracking_number: string | null — carrier tracking code once dispatched, else null

fields.status: enum: authorized | captured | declined — authorized == card accepted pending capture; captured == money taken (marks Order paid); declined == card refused
fields.processor_ref: string | null — payment-processor reference for the attempt

Extends the single canonical dataset — no second Payment dataset was created.
